name: Loose Oats
description:
A four-pound measure of dry oats is scooped from the stable bin. It supplements suitable fodder rather than claiming to feed every mount for a whole day.

Sold as one four-pound measure of oats. Weight includes light disposable wrapping or tying where needed; reusable bags, vessels and drinking water are separate. Partial use is tracked manually.

weight.notes: Adjusted total for one four-pound measure of oats, including light wrapping or tying where applicable. Excludes reusable containers and water; feed remains a meaningful carried load.
